title: Bubble Symphony
native_title: バブル・シンフォニー
overview:
Pretty horns! Cute feet!! Dangerous bellies!!! Spanning generations, those adorable guys are back.

Bubble Symphony is the arcade follow-up to Bubble Bobble, licensed from Taito. Four children - Bubblun, Bobblun, Kululun and Cororon - are turned into bubble dragons by the villain Hyper Drunk and cast into a strange new world. Trap enemies in bubbles and pop them, screen by screen, and hold the button to charge a triple-bubble shot whose pattern depends on your dragon. Each of the four has their own speed, bubble range and shot formation. Familiar faces turn up in the boss battles, and after each boss you pick one of two doors to choose your route. Collect the music note cards to earn the keys needed for the final world, and watch for the mysterious code hidden in the bonus stages.

- 1 or 2 players simultaneously
- Four selectable dragons with different abilities
- Branching routes
- Memory backup save
